note: Old strip-mined land west of Clinton, steep spoil ridges with deep strip-pit lakes. MDC marks six primitive camping spots, each beside a small gravel lot on the area's gravel roads off Highway 7; most are at pit-side lane ends in the woods. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites', Rule 140 standard; map (2/18/2022) six 'Primitive Camping' symbols each at a Parking Lot = GIS 592-597. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual; 2027 $5 MDC permit in fees.note. Pin (GIS 597) is the dead end of a narrow wooded lane with no visible pad or turnaround - move to the open lot by GIS 594, 220 m S. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; Rule 140 standard text, no permit rule. Map (2/18/2022) legend 'Primitive Camping' and 'Parking Lot'; six camping symbols, each at a parking lot (GIS 27: 592-597, each within ~15 m of a GIS 26 lot). Brochure: 'Motor vehicles are restricted to graveled roadways and parking areas.' Designated points at lots - stay. No horse camp, ford, 4WD or rig wording. FIT CAVEAT: the stored pin's camp (597 / lot 1543) is the dead end of a single-track gravel lane ~100 m long along a strip-pit arm, under trees, with no pad or turnaround visible in leaf-off imagery - a 23-ft rig would back out. The GIS 594 camp (lot 286) is an open gravel pull-off at a junction on the main gravel road, which a rig can use without backing.
PIN: stored 38.41200,-93.83219 = GIS 597 / lot 1543, the wooded lane end above. Move to the GIS 594 lot: 38.41000,-93.83234 (222 m S).

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept for the proposed 594 pin, which is ~150 m from any pit through woods). Lead for the stored 597 lane end: it is ~10-20 m from a strip-pit arm (the joined Pits 8/9, several acres) through a thin wooded bank - a filtered view at most, no open apron; not upgraded.

CLUSTERS: six camps spread ~2 km across one connected gravel road network (NW-350P RD / NW-300 RD / NW-551P) with several road entries; each is a single small lot - no split. near.py: nothing else in campgrounds.json within 3 km.
PHONE: area page 'For more information call (660) 885-6981' matches stored.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. Area hours 4 a.m.-10 p.m. apply except to authorized camping.

FEES FROM MARCH 2027 (applies to every MDC area entry and the state:missouri-conservation-areas policy row): MDC release https://mdc.mo.gov/node/307038 ('Campers will need permits to camp on MDC areas starting in March'): 'The Missouri Conservation Commission gave final approval at its Oct. 23 open meeting ... to regulation changes ... that would require campers to purchase a permit to camp on MDC areas starting in March 2027'; 'purchase a permit for $5 for up to five days of camping on conservation areas for up to 10 people'; 'Each person will be limited to three consecutive camping permits and six camping permits annually'; 'available for purchase beginning in March online, at a permit vendor, or over the phone'. The camping page still says 'All camping on conservation areas is free' (true until then), so nightly_low/high 0 written as today's value with the 2027 permit in fees.note; the policy row's fees and booking note need the same update.
Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights), 'site length not published' and directions dropped; the strip-pit setting and the lot camps put in.
